verdict.rationale: Stripe Terminal explicitly documents an API-based server-driven integration path alongside its SDKs, letting developers build a fully custom POS backend-driven flow, with supporting fleet management (register readers via API, locations/zones), offline payment handling, and a simulated reader for testing without hardware. Community evidence corroborates that full API-level terminal integration is achievable and powerful for building custom POS on top of Stripe. Missing for 10: deeper hands-on independent verification of the full server-driven request/response flow (e.g., process_payment_intent lifecycle) and more detailed API reference walkthrough beyond high-level doc summaries.
